bundle.shortDescription: Frees disk space by clearing caches and old temporary files.
bundle.longDescription: Space Optimiser scans a fixed list of caches and temporary folders, shows what each cleanup does, and removes only what you confirm. It does not upload a list of your files and does not run as administrator.
